description: This file contains functions for canonicalizing computational graphs in PyTorch's JIT compiler, including renumbering graphs, establishing node orderings, and canonicalizing control flow outputs.

methods.name: Canonicalize
methods.description: Renumbers and canonicalizes a graph to ensure structural equivalence and consistent ordering.

methods.name: blockIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of a block within its owning node.

methods.name: isBefore
methods.description: Determines if one node or use occurs before another in the canonical order.

methods.name: isAfter
methods.description: Determines if one use occurs after another.

methods.name: isBeforeOrAfter
methods.description: Checks ordering of uses based on a boolean flag.

methods.name: firstOrLastUse
methods.description: Finds the first or last use of a value.

methods.name: gatherFirstUses
methods.description: Gathers the first uses of a list of values.

methods.name: sort_indexes
methods.description: Returns indexes of values sorted by their first usage order.

methods.name: CanonicalizeLoopOutputs
methods.description: Reorders loop outputs to canonical order.

methods.name: CanonicalizeIfOutputs
methods.description: Reorders if-node outputs to canonical order.

methods.name: CanonicalizeOutputs
methods.description: Canonicalizes control flow node outputs within a graph.
